displayPattern: 7-segment display on an American Standard S9V2 two-stage variable-speed furnace: E12
meaning: Open fuse. The control diagram in this installer's guide labels the low-voltage fuse as 5 amp.
causes: Open fuse on the furnace control
diySteps: If the display is dark, a blown fuse is one reason this guide lists. Do not install a higher-amp fuse
Technician: find why the fuse opened, then replace it with the 5 amp fuse shown on the control diagram
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician if the fuse is open or opens again. The guide does not give a homeowner wiring repair for E12.
